subject: Zenith Tech - Renewal & Expansion Recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@zenithtech.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@zenithtech.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 2 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Zenith Tech - Renewal & Expansion Recap

Hi Alex / Priya -

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our renewal/expansion call and next steps so everyone has the same view. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of current state / pain points
- Monthly token usage: ~1.2B tokens (Mar 2026) with peak bursts during batch scoring. See attached usage export for details.
- Latency-sensitive endpoints (search reranking & agent calls) experiencing occasional tail latency spikes during concurrent batch runs.
- Cost: increased spend after Q4 model changes - finance wants predictable unit cost for next 12 months.

Customer goals
- Lock in predictable pricing & committed capacity for 2026 renewal window.
- Reduce tail latency for reranking / agent workloads below 250ms p95.
- Add support for a new high-throughput embedding workload (approx +300M tokens/month) planned for Q3.

Proposed expansion path we discussed
1) Renewal: 12-month committed capacity (Dedicated pool) with a target baseline that covers current steady-state usage.
2) Expansion: Add a dedicated embedding cluster for the Q3 workload; suggest a pilot in June with a deterministic SLA and autoscaling burst.
3) Reliability: Schedule a technical workshop to optimize batch configurations and KV caching to drop p95 tail latency.
4) Commercials: Draft quote attached with a recommended discount structure tied to volume bands; open to aligning on internal finance reqs.

Next steps (owners & timing)
- Marissa (me): Send usage export + draft quote (attached). Target by EOD May 2. [Done - usage attached]
- Alex: Confirm internal procurement timeline and whether procurement@zenithtech.com should be on contract threads. (Answer requested by May 7)
- Naomi: Schedule technical workshop w/ Rishi (tentative week of May 18).
- Rishi: Prepare workshop agenda and pre-read (infrastructure, model variants, quantization guidance).

Attachments:
- zenith_monthly_usage_Mar-2026.pdf (CSV summary + charts)

If that aligns, I will follow up with a workshop invite and an updated quote reflecting a baseline commit + embedding cluster pilot.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@zenithtech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@zenithtech.com>, procurement@zenithtech.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Zenith Tech - Renewal & Expansion Recap

Thanks Marissa - useful summary and appreciated the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifications from our side: \
\
1) Procurement / timeline: We are targeting an internal renewal approval by mid-June to align budget with the July 1 renewal effective date. I've looped in procurement for contract discussions.
2) SLA question: Can you confirm whether the Dedicated pool SLA covers p95 tail latency for routing-sensitive endpoints, or do we need an add-on? We need to know if the embedding cluster pilot can include the same SLA.
3) Pilot scope: For the embedding workload, we want a two-week pilot running exactly our production batch scoring pipeline (no sampling). Can you commit to that pilot being capacity-isolated?

I'll follow up with procurement on required contract terms. For the workshop week of May 18 - Priya and I can be available May 19 in the afternoon PT.

Cheers,
Alex
Alex Turner
VP, ML Engineering | Zenith Tech
alex.turner@zenithtech.com | +1 (617) 555-9988

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@zenithtech.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@zenithtech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Zenith Tech - Renewal & Expansion Recap

Alex - thanks, good notes. Quick answers and updates: \
\
- SLA: Dedicated pool SLA covers uptime and baseline throughput; tail-latency SLOs for p95 can be included as part of an SLA addendum for Dedicated + embedding cluster. I'll have legal/ops draft the addendum once procurement confirms contract cadence.
- Pilot isolation: Yes - we can provision an isolated embedding cluster for a two-week production pilot. We'll ensure capacity isolation and monitoring.
- Workshop: May 19 at 2:00 PM PT works for our team. Rishi will lead the deep-dive and bring a pre-read.

I've attached a draft quote (zenith_draft_quote_May-2026.pdf) that reflects: baseline commit for 12 months, pilot credits for June, and tiered volume discounts for Q3 onward. The quote includes an initial starter discount; any larger, custom discount needs approvals from the revenue ops manager (I am initiating that discussion).

Next steps (updated)
- Marissa: Share updated quote + legal addendum template (by May 7).
- Rishi: Workshop pre-read and perf checklist (by May 14).
- Procurement (Alex): Confirm contract owner and any PO process specifics (by May 7).

Thanks all - looking forward to the workshop.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments:
- zenith_draft_quote_May-2026.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Zenith Tech - Renewal & Expansion Recap

Internal note - copying key owners. Procurement timeline looks like mid-June approval, workshop confirmed for May 19 at 2:00 PM PT.\

Commercials: I attached the draft quote in the external thread - recommending we offer the starter discount in the quote and hold larger concession ask until we have the pilot results. Finance wants to see commit bands mapped to monthly cost reduction targets before approving additional discount.

Rishi: please prioritize the workshop pre-read; include: batch sizing, KV cache tuning, recommended quantization profile for embeddings, and a quick checklist to verify capacity isolation. Also prep a quick performance runbook we can hand to Zenith's SREs during the pilot.

Naomi: I'll need you to own the contract coordination once procurement gives name. If they request a CAF or special clause, escalate to me and I'll loop revenue ops.

Thanks - I will send the calendar invite and upload the pre-read to the shared drive.

Marissa
